panels.description: Durchschnittlicher Jitter-Wert der Anrufe im Zeitraum

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN avg(q.a_rx_jitter) IS NULL AND avg(q.b_rx_jitter) IS NULL AND avg(q.a_tx_jitter) IS NULL AND avg(q.b_tx_jitter) IS NULL
      THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce(avg(q.a_rx_jitter), 0) + coalesce(avg(q.b_rx_jitter), 0) + coalesce(avg(q.a_tx_jitter), 0) + coalesce(avg(q.b_tx_jitter), 0)
  END
  /
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(avg(q.a_rx_jitter), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(avg(q.b_rx_jitter), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(avg(q.a_tx_jitter), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(avg(q.b_tx_jitter), 0) = 0 THEN 1
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.a_rx_jitter) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END +
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.b_rx_jitter) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END +
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.a_tx_jitter) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END +
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.b_tx_jitter) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  END
  AS avg_jitter
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN avg(q.a_rtt) IS NULL AND avg(q.b_rtt) IS NULL
      THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce(avg(q.a_rtt), 0) + coalesce(avg(q.b_rtt), 0)
  END
  /
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(avg(q.a_rtt), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(avg(q.b_rtt), 0) = 0 THEN 1
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.a_rtt) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END +
      CASE
        WHEN avg(q.b_rtt) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  END
  AS avg_rtt
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
;

SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(q.time_stamp, MINUTE) AS time_bucket,
  avg(LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx)) AS mos_score,
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket
;

WITH ab_stat AS (
  SELECT
    q.a_codec AS codec,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
  WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
  GROUP BY q.a_codec
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    q.b_codec AS codec,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
  WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
  GROUP BY q.b_codec
)
SELECT
  s.codec,
  sum(s.row_count) AS row_count
FROM ab_stat AS s
GROUP BY s.codec
ORDER BY row_count
;

SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(q.time_stamp, MINUTE) AS time_bucket,
  avg(
    CASE
      WHEN q.a_rx_loss IS NULL AND q.b_rx_loss IS NULL AND q.a_tx_loss IS NULL AND q.b_tx_loss IS NULL
        THEN 0
      ELSE coalesce(q.a_rx_loss, 0) + coalesce(q.b_rx_loss, 0) + coalesce(q.a_tx_loss, 0) + coalesce(q.b_tx_loss, 0)
    END
    /
    CASE
      WHEN coalesce(q.a_rx_loss, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(q.b_rx_loss, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(q.a_tx_loss, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(q.b_tx_loss, 0) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN q.a_rx_loss >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE
          WHEN q.b_rx_loss >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE
          WHEN q.a_tx_loss >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE
          WHEN q.b_tx_loss >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    END
  ) AS avg_loss,
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket
;

SELECT
  0 AS row_order,
  'Unknown' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND (LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) IS NULL OR LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 0.1)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  1 AS row_order,
  'Poor' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) >= 0.1 AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  2 AS row_order,
  'Low' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) >= 3.1 AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.5
UNION ALL
SELECT
  3 AS row_order,
  'Medium' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) >= 3.5 AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.8
UNION ALL
SELECT
  4 AS row_order,
  'High' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) >= 3.8 AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 4.2
UNION ALL
SELECT
  5 AS row_order,
  'Excellent' AS mos_overall_score,
  count(*) AS number_of_calls
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
AND LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) >= 4.2
ORDER BY row_order
;

SELECT
  q.time_stamp AS started_at,
  CASE
    WHEN q.summary = 0  -- 0 = Unknown
      -- CQSummaryUnknown = Incomplete
      THEN '⚠️ ' || 'Incomplete'
    WHEN q.summary = 1  -- 1 = AllGood
      -- CQSummaryAllGood = No problems detected
      THEN '✅ ' || 'No problems detected'
    WHEN q.summary = 2  -- 2 = NetworkToParty1 [NetworkToP1]
      -- CQSummaryToP1 = Network problems from PBX to %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems from PBX to %s', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 3  -- 3 = NetworkFromParty1 [NetworkFromP1]
      -- CQSummaryFromP1 = Network problems from %s to PBX
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems from %s to PBX', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 4  -- 4 = NetworkParty1AndPbx [NetworkP1andPbx]
      -- CQSummaryP1andPbx = Network problems between PBX and %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems between PBX and %s', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 5  -- 5 = NetworkToParty2 [NetworkToP2]
      -- CQSummaryToP1 = Network problems from PBX to %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems from PBX to %s', coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 6  -- 6 = NetworkFromParty2 [NetworkFromP2]
      -- CQSummaryFromP1 = Network problems from %s to PBX
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems from %s to PBX', coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 7  -- 7 = NetworkParty2AndPbx [NetworkP2andPbx]
      -- CQSummaryP1andPbx = Network problems between PBX and %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems between PBX and %s', coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 8  -- 8 = ToPbx
      -- CQSummaryToPbx = Network problems in direction to PBX from both %s and %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems in direction to PBX from both %s and %s', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'), coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 9  -- 9 = FromPbx
      -- CQSummaryFromPbx = Network problems in direction from PBX to both %s and %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems in direction from PBX to both %s and %s', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'), coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    WHEN q.summary = 10  -- 10 = FromToPbX
      -- CQSummaryFromToPbX = Network problems between PBX and both %s and %s
      THEN '⚠️ ' || FORMAT('Network problems between PBX and both %s and %s', coalesce(q.a_number, 'Unknown'), coalesce(q.b_number, 'Unknown'))
    ELSE '⚠️ ' || 'Generic Problems'
  END AS summary_overal,
  CASE
    WHEN q.summary = 0  -- 0 = Unknown
      THEN 'Direct (RTP stream bypass)'
    WHEN q.transcoding
      THEN 'Transcoding'
    ELSE 'Proxy'
  END AS mode,
  CASE
    WHEN LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) IS NULL OR LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 0.1
      THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.1
      THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.5
      THEN 'Low'
    WHEN LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 3.8
      THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN LEAST(q.a_mos_to_pbx, q.b_mos_to_pbx, q.a_mos_from_pbx, q.b_mos_from_pbx) < 4.2
      THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END AS mos_overall_score,
  CASE
    WHEN q.a_mos_to_pbx IS NULL OR q.a_mos_to_pbx < 0.1
      THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN q.a_mos_to_pbx < 3.1
      THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN q.a_mos_to_pbx < 3.5
      THEN 'Low'
    WHEN q.a_mos_to_pbx < 3.8
      THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN q.a_mos_to_pbx < 4.2
      THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END AS a_mos_to_pbx_score,
  CASE
    WHEN q.b_mos_to_pbx IS NULL OR q.b_mos_to_pbx < 0.1
      THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN q.b_mos_to_pbx < 3.1
      THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN q.b_mos_to_pbx < 3.5
      THEN 'Low'
    WHEN q.b_mos_to_pbx < 3.8
      THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN q.b_mos_to_pbx < 4.2
      THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END AS b_mos_to_pbx_score,
  CASE
    WHEN q.a_mos_from_pbx IS NULL OR q.a_mos_from_pbx < 0.1
      THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN q.a_mos_from_pbx < 3.1
      THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN q.a_mos_from_pbx < 3.5
      THEN 'Low'
    WHEN q.a_mos_from_pbx < 3.8
      THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN q.a_mos_from_pbx < 4.2
      THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END AS a_mos_from_pbx_score,
  CASE
    WHEN q.b_mos_from_pbx IS NULL OR q.b_mos_from_pbx < 0.1
      THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN q.b_mos_from_pbx < 3.1
      THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN q.b_mos_from_pbx < 3.5
      THEN 'Low'
    WHEN q.b_mos_from_pbx < 3.8
      THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN q.b_mos_from_pbx < 4.2
      THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END AS b_mos_from_pbx_score,
  q.a_number || ' ' || coalesce(q.a_name, 'Unknown') AS a_participant,
  q.a_duration,   -- in seconds
  q.b_number || ' ' || coalesce(q.b_name, 'Unknown') AS b_participant,
  q.b_duration,   -- in seconds
  CASE
    WHEN q.a_location IS NULL THEN ''
    WHEN q.a_location = 0 THEN 'Local'
    WHEN q.a_location = 1 THEN 'External'
    WHEN q.a_location = 2 THEN 'Tunnel'
    WHEN q.a_location = 3 THEN 'STUN'
  END AS a_location_type,
  CASE
    WHEN q.b_location IS NULL THEN ''
    WHEN q.b_location = 0 THEN 'Local'
    WHEN q.b_location = 1 THEN 'External'
    WHEN q.b_location = 2 THEN 'Tunnel'
    WHEN q.b_location = 3 THEN 'STUN'
  END AS b_location_type,
  coalesce(q.a_tun_address, 'Unknown') AS a_address,
  coalesce(q.b_tun_address, 'Unknown') AS b_address,
  q.a_codec,
  q.b_codec,
  q.a_rtt,
  q.b_rtt,
  q.a_rx,
  q.a_rx_loss,
  q.a_rx_jitter,
  q.b_rx,
  q.b_rx_loss,
  q.b_rx_jitter,
  q.a_tx,
  q.a_tx_loss,
  q.a_tx_jitter,
  q.b_tx,
  q.b_tx_loss,
  q.b_tx_jitter
FROM `3cx_call_data.public_cl_quality` AS q
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.time_stamp)
ORDER BY q.time_stamp DESC
;
